name: Highlight trace
one_line: An accent travels along an already-drawn path, lighting each element in order
summary: On a finished diagram or route, a single accent moves along the path or down the sequence, lighting each element as it passes. It recaps order, shows flow or points the viewer to the next thing to read. Lighting several places at once, or leaving traces that never settle, blurs where the eye should be.

routes.one_line: Sweep an accent along SVG elements with Anime.js on a seeked timeline

steps.does: Light each element in order, then return it to its resting style

limits: The fixture lights four nodes in turn; a highlight on connectors or text is untested
No motion-path method is guided, so the accent steps between elements; it does not glide along the line
Elements must carry stable ids; optimising the SVG can strip them

routes.one_line: Offset per-element Web Animations so the accent passes along in sequence

steps.does: Give each element a highlight animation with an onset offset by order

limits: Evidence covers opacity, transform and a stroke draw, not colour changes along a path
A highlight that moves smoothly along a curve between elements needs a path method the tool does not guide

routes.one_line: Redraw the diagram on a 2D canvas with an accent positioned along the path at t

steps.does: Draw the diagram and an accent at the point reached at t each seek

limits: Evidence includes an arc and a gradient, not a travelling mark on a path
A glow around the accent is outside the evidence

source: references/motion-director §4.2, references/data-visualisation §3.4, references/art-director §5.3; tool records as of 2026-11-20
